title: Turn over time
prompt: Something facing angle degrees turns at turn_speed degrees per second. Return the angle after one frame.
signature: func solve(angle: float, turn_speed: float, delta: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(angle: float, turn_speed: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return angle
hint: Degrees per second times seconds gives degrees.
solution:
func solve(angle: float, turn_speed: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return angle + turn_speed * delta
